arms.name: rlm-full
arms.note: Treatment arm against the typed sub-tasks. Three repeats of one query so the spread is measured, not assumed: the arms are unchanged from the W1 rerun apart from the sub-task section of the prompt, the 10-iteration cap and the 500k token cap.

queries.text: Across the retrieved papers, what methods do recursive language model systems use to aggregate information that exceeds a single context window, and how do they differ in where the aggregation happens?
queries.note: The W1 aggregation query, so these runs line up against m11-w1-v2.rlm-full.aggregation row for row. It is the cell with the most tool calls and the widest cost spread, which is where a change in how the evidence is compressed should show up first.
